setup_text: In the corner of the room, the party finds a small shrine carved into the stone. Faded offerings sit before a symbol none of them recognize. {slot_0} kneels to examine it. {slot_1} hangs back.

dialogue.line: 'Someone worshipped here. A long time ago.'
'And look how well it worked out for them.'

choices.label: Pay respects
choices.description: Leave a small offering at the shrine.

marks.name: Honored an old shrine on floor {floor}
marks.origin: Paused to show reverence to the forgotten

choices.label: Move on
choices.description: Old stone and dead offerings. Nothing useful here.

llm_context.scene_mood: Quiet discovery. A reminder that others came before and didn't make it out.

slot_guidance.tone: Respectful, contemplative. Sees meaning in small things.
Dismissive but not hostile. Thinks faith is pointless down here.
